notes.title: MonTamer Christmas Special
notes.content:
Merry Christmas

I wish everyone a Merry Christmas! To celebrate the feast I have published a small Christmas special on the YouTube channel. 
 
[previewyoutube=knyEZ-841bU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Weather system
The weather system in MonTamer will provide dynamic weather and make snow fall during winter time. There will also be rain in MonTamer. 

The different weather conditions will also have an effect on the world in MonTamer. Among other things, freezing lakes will make new areas accessible for exploration, and new Montams will appear that can only be found in snowy conditions. The same goes for Montams that only appear in the wilderness when it rains. 


We hope you like this little update and wish you a Merry Christmas.
